title: CLIPPED WINGS
hud: Take the Paleto Forest bunker gate, then bring down the escaping Osprey from the gun truck.
synopsis: Aegis never cleared out of the Paleto Forest bunker. Guess drives the crew north up the Great Ocean Highway in a gun truck, and the three of them take the men at the gate and the guard post. A pilot reaches the Osprey parked on the apron and lifts off. It runs along the coast road through Paleto Bay; Guess keeps the truck under it, Ice works the gun in the bed with a launcher on his back, and Gohan calls the hull from the passenger seat until it comes down. With the last of Aegis's aircraft in the trees, the same airframe comes up for sale.
